description: A comprehensive shell script for managing crash and minidump files: detecting, processing, compressing, and uploading crash reports to cloud services, with support for retries, rate limiting, blacklisting, and configuration overrides.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Generates a log filename based on input parameters, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Logs a message with timestamp and process ID to core log.

methods.name: logStdout
methods.description: Logs each line read from stdin to core log.

methods.name: create_lock_or_exit
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or exits if already locked.

methods.name: create_lock_or_wait
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or waits until it can.

methods.name: remove_lock
methods.description: Removes a lock directory.

methods.name: getOptOutStatus
methods.description: Checks if telemetry opt-out is enabled.

methods.name: checkParameter
methods.description: Ensures critical parameters are set, assigns defaults if empty.

methods.name: checkMAC
methods.description: Ensures MAC address is obtained and formatted.

methods.name: deleteAllButTheMostRecentFile
methods.description: Deletes older dump files, keeping only the most recent.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up old or incomplete dump files and logs.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup and releases locks on script exit.

methods.name: isBoxRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the box is rebooting to skip upload.

methods.name: isBuildBlacklisted
methods.description: Checks if the current build is blacklisted for upload.

methods.name: isUploadLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if crash upload rate limit has been reached.

methods.name: setRecoveryTime
methods.description: Sets a recovery time window during which uploads are blocked.

methods.name: isRecoveryTimeReached
methods.description: Checks if the recovery window has passed.

methods.name: removePendingDumps
methods.description: Removes dump files pending upload due to rate limiting or blacklisting.

methods.name: markAsCrashLoopedAndUpload
methods.description: Renames a dump as crashlooped and uploads it.

methods.name: downloadBlacklist
methods.description: Downloads blacklist from S3 to prevent uploads of blacklisted builds.

methods.name: uploadToS3
methods.description: Signs and uploads dump files to Amazon S3 or via MTLS, with retries and error handling.

methods.name: codebigUpload
methods.description: Performs upload via CodeBig service with signed URL.
